headline: GVP Infotech announces changes to its articles and memorandum of association
summary: GVP Infotech Limited has formally notified the stock exchange regarding amendments made to its Articles of Association and Memorandum of Association. Such procedural updates are routine corporate housekeeping matters required for altering internal rules or business objects. Indian retail investors holding this micro-cap stock should note that administrative changes of this nature rarely impact near-term financial performance or share price.
why_it_matters: No direct financial impact on retail shareholders.

headline: GVP Infotech submits AGM voting results and scrutinizer report
hook: Procedural compliance filing from GVP Infotech
summary: GVP Infotech Limited has submitted the scrutinizer's report and voting results for its Annual General Meeting held on September 29, 2026, to the stock exchange. This is a routine regulatory compliance filing required for listed entities following shareholder meetings. For an Indian retail investor, this holds negligible financial impact as it contains no corporate earnings, fundraising, or strategic updates. The disclosure merely concludes the procedural formalities of the company's annual gathering.
why_it_matters: No direct financial consequence for retail shareholders
